posts.title: Alert 11/30-12/21: 3-week Boyer Ave closure might make the street … better?

posts.title: County will create temporary bike lane during U Bridge trolley wire work
posts.description: King County Metro is starting work on a months-long project to replace some trolley wire poles on the University Bridge that will displace the current bike lane in places. posts.title: Seattle ranks 3rd among large US cities in revamped People for Bikes list
posts.description: People for Bikes, an industry-supported bike advocacy organization, has revamped its methodology for how it ranks bike-friendly cities, and Seattle once again ranks third among U.S. cities with more than 300,000 residents. Only Brooklyn and Minneapolis ranked higher. The rating puts Seattle in the 92nd percentile out of 3,422 cities worldwide. Seattle ranked third under […]
